tools.name: inspect_revenue_opportunity
tools.description: Use this first when deciding whether a business has recoverable missed-call or follow-up revenue leakage. Returns a score, estimated monthly leak, recoverable revenue, and next action. Execution costs $0.005 via x402 Base USDC.

tools.name: route_task
tools.description: Use this when the caller needs to discover and rank live x402 providers for a task before choosing downstream spend. KlearFlow does not execute the selected provider. Routing costs $0.005 via x402 Base USDC.

tools.name: recover_revenue
tools.description: Use this after a specific revenue-loss event already happened and the caller needs the next recovery action. Returns a prioritized decision packet; KlearFlow sends no external message. Execution costs $0.05 via x402 Base USDC.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "inspect_revenue_opportunity" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Inspect a real business for missed-call revenue leakage, estimate recoverable monthly revenue, and return the recommended next commercial action. Launch execution costs $0.01 via x402 Base USDC." → after: "Use this first when deciding whether a business has recoverable missed-call or follow-up revenue leakage. Returns a score, estimated monthly leak, recoverable revenue, and next action. Execution costs $0.005 via x402 Base USDC."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
